notes: Open/exposed states are treated as on and closed/assembled states as off. The two double-door upper cabinets are represented as cabinet assemblies because both leaves change together within the same sampled manipulation interval; individual leaf timing cannot be resolved from the provided frames.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen and sequentially opens and closes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper cabinets, followed by lids or drawers on several countertop cooking appliances.
